editorial:
You know that feeling when your ex texts you out of nowhere and suddenly your whole life gets turned upside down? That is basically the starting point here. Two best friends in their thirties, played by Mila Kunis and Kate McKinnon, get dragged into a wild international spy mess when one of their ex-boyfriends shows up with assassins chasing him. What follows is a globe-trotting adventure full of car chases, shootouts, and plenty of laughs. The chemistry between the two leads is the real heart of the movie, and their friendship feels genuine and warm even when everything around them is exploding.

The action scenes are surprisingly well done for a comedy, with some genuinely thrilling set pieces that keep you on the edge of your seat. McKinnon steals nearly every scene she is in with her goofy energy, while Kunis grounds the story with a more relatable, everywoman performance. The pacing moves quickly and rarely drags, though some jokes land better than others. If you enjoy buddy comedies with a spy twist, this one is a fun ride. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final act, the friends discover that the ex-boyfriend was actually a rogue agent hiding a secret flash drive containing dangerous information. After a chaotic showdown across Europe, they manage to outsmart the villains and hand the drive to the right authorities. The twist reveals that the seemingly helpful spy ally was playing both sides all along. In the end, the two friends walk away as unlikely heroes, their bond stronger than ever, and they even get recruited for future spy work.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves buddy comedies with action and strong female friendships.
